steps.description: Validate that smoothed Cp file contains positive values, covers at least 0–298.15 K, and has no obviously impossible values.
Check structural shape of the Cp curve: monotonic increase below 223 K, presence of a hump (Cp higher at 270 K than at 220 and 298.15 K).
Recompute S(298.15 K) and H-H0(298.15 K) by trapezoidal integration of the submitted smoothed Cp and compare to paper gold with tolerance.
Verify that the values in final_values.json are consistent with the smoothed Cp (recomputed S and H match the file within tight tolerance).
Check that S and H in thermodynamic_properties.csv at selected temperatures are consistent with the submitted smoothed Cp.
